about.name: Shanaaz Ahamed
about.title: Software Engineer
description: Over two years of experience building enterprise healthcare software. Full-stack Java developer using Spring Boot and Angular on a microservices architecture, with strong Python, Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD experience. Experienced with PostgreSQL, Oracle, Liquibase and Keycloak.
Currently pursuing an MSc in Computer Science (Cloud Computing) researching proactive, in-place Kubernetes autoscaling using workload forecasting and multi-agent reinforcement learning.
about.headline: Software Engineer building enterprise healthcare systems

groups.title: Finance and Admin Module (Java, Spring Boot, Angular)
descriptions: Develop full-stack features for the Finance and Admin modules of VIDA4, a microservices-based Health Information System (HIS) used across HMG hospitals in Saudi Arabia, Bahrain and the UAE.
Build backend services and REST APIs in Java with Spring Boot, and frontend features in Angular and TypeScript.
Work with PostgreSQL and Oracle databases and manage schema changes with Liquibase.
Provide production support: investigate and resolve live issues, deliver bug fixes and hotfixes, and keep the modules stable for hospital users.

groups.title: Special Projects, R&D (Python, Docker, Kubernetes, Keycloak)
descriptions: Automated VIDA4 release and deployment in Python: a CI/CD pipeline that packages and applies every artifact the microservices need to run (UI translations, permissions, configurations, backend Liquibase changelogs), removing manual steps and speeding up environment setup and release rollouts.

Implemented ArgoCD PreSync and PostSync hooks with Kubernetes init containers to apply all deployment artifacts (schema and data migrations, master data, configurations) across microservices in the correct order.
Upgraded customised Keycloak source (coupled with VIDA4) from version 6 to 26: updated custom Java SPIs for compatibility and fully migrated admin console and login UI from AngularJS to React.

experiences.position: Data Science Intern, Access and Network Planning
descriptions: Built an MDT data processing and visualisation web application and machine learning anomaly detection models for cellular network data (Python, ReactJS).

education.field: MSc in Computer Science, Specialisation in Cloud Computing

descriptions: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

projects.title: PRIMA-K8s: Proactive Multi-Agent In-Place Autoscaling for Kubernetes
projects.description: MSc research: a Kubernetes autoscaling framework that forecasts workload demand with a Transformer model (PyTorch) and resizes running pods in place via the Pod Resize API. Cooperative multi-agent RL agents (MAPPO, Ray RLlib) allocate CPU and memory across microservices, run by a Python Kubernetes operator (kopf) with Prometheus monitoring.

projects.title: Enhancing Outdoor Computer Vision in Resource-Constrained Environments
projects.description: Final year research project: engineered a dynamic model-switching mechanism that automatically adapts to changing environmental domains (lighting, weather), combined with deep learning model pruning and quantisation for edge deployment.

projects.title: Canny Edge Detection from Scratch
projects.description: Canny edge detection implemented from first principles in Python with grayscale conversion, Gaussian blur, gradient estimation, non-maximum suppression and dual thresholding, using only NumPy and Matplotlib.
